label: FP
reason: The CodeQL alert reports java/xss based on the reflection of user input into the fileName variable used in printWriter.println(). However, the actual vulnerable sink is the FileOutputStream constructor which writes directly to disk, not the HTML response writer. The ESAPI encoder.encodeForHTML() call only encodes the fileName for display purposes in the log message, preventing XSS in the browser response. Since the user input never reaches an unsanitized HTML sink, there is no XSS vulnerability on this path.

evidence.note: User input flows to fileName which is written to disk via FileOutputStream (safe) and also printed to response via encodeForHTML() (sanitized), meaning no XSS occurs.
